system.model: gemini-1.5-flash for complex classification and drafting; local deterministic safety parser for injection/threat detection
system.preference_demo: m015: always CC Priya on Hartwell & Cho legal mail

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate) with a stated reason, leaving none undecided.
capabilities.observable: Prints a table of all 54 messages, each with a disposition and reason, then 'undecided: 0'. Also writes decisions.json.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply grounded in a specific earlier message and records cited message IDs.
capabilities.observable: Prints a draft answering m008 that contains the staging AMQP URL from m003, plus 'cited: [m003]'.

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends or deletes without human approval or an explicit --dry-run that suppresses outbox writes.
capabilities.observable: Prints proposed send action, followed by 'outbox/ writes: 0'. Re-running without --dry-run prompts y/n before writing to outbox/.

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Records a stated preference from mail and applies it across process restarts.
capabilities.observable: Stores preference from m015 into prefs.json. Next process handles legal mail m018 and automatically loops priya@paperjet.io into CC.
capabilities.evidence: prefs.json on disk; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R4

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects hostile instructions inside message bodies, suppresses them, logs refusals, and alerts the user without deleting them.
capabilities.observable: Detects injections in m017, m024, m039, m047; suppresses exfiltration and writes 'FLAGGED' refusals to console and trace.

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a three-pane view (pending actions, flagged threats, commitments with conflicts surfaced) reproducible from a run.
capabilities.observable: Generates dashboard.html and dashboard.json. Surfaces conflict between m010 (VC call) and m061 (Dentist) at Tue 15:00, and cites m038+m040 for board deck.
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.html, dashboard.json; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R6

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: Finds sent messages awaiting reply for over 3 days and generates follow-up nudges.
capabilities.observable: Outputs JSON identifying m044 (sent to Priya 6 days ago with no reply) with a prepared chase draft.

capabilities.name: Morning digest
capabilities.claim: Produces a single-screen executive briefing of priorities, deferred obligations, and rule-archived noise.
capabilities.observable: Prints a 3-part digest showing actionable items (m018, m010), waitlisted deliverables (m040), and 28 auto-archived items.
